Formatting / presentation
* Please study the formatting syntax described on this page: https://www.codingame.com/playgrounds/40701/help-center/statement , and format your statement properly as described in the points below.

Goal
* The current statement doesn't specify the possible operations, and the guarantee about divisibility is a constraint. Please rewrite as follows:

You are given a number and an operation. Your task is to perform the operation on the number. The operation will be either {{DOUBLE}} or {{HALF}}.

Constraints
* Please format "N" as a [[variable]].

* Please add:
[[N]] is even when [[operator]] is {{HALF}}.

Input
* Please format "Line 1" and "Line 2" in <<bold>>.

* Please format "N" and "operator" as [[variables]].

* Please remove the 'quotation marks'.

* Please change "onto" to "on".

Output
* Please format "Line 1" in <<bold>>.

* Please remove "N".

Cases
* Test 3: Please change N to even.

* Test 5: Please remove the trailing newline from the input.

* Please add Test 6 and Validator 6, where N is an odd integer greater than 0 and operator is DOUBLE.

* Please add Test 7 and Validator 7, where N is an odd integer less than 0 and operator is DOUBLE.

* Please add Test 8 and Validator 8, where N = 0 and operator is HALF.

Thanks.
It took me quite some time to tinker and come up with this, hope you guys enjoy! Have a nice day! :)
It looks like you've revised the cases since I posted my comment. I'll have to review the revised cases.
